risk_flags.description: The contract commits to documenting behavior that contradicts the project's reference requirement. The authoritative rules say expenses are converted to US dollars when recorded, not stored in the entered currency.
risk_flags.span: The section clearly states that amounts are stored in the currency they were entered in

risk_flags.description: The README cannot be treated as an independent source of truth here. If the README disagrees with the requirements, the requirements explicitly win, so this change would create a known contradiction.
risk_flags.span: where the code, the README, or the marketing copy disagree with this document, this document wins until it is deliberately changed.

verdict.primary_risk: The proposed contract would make README.md state the opposite of the authoritative product requirement for currency storage.
